description: The binary realtime protocol between SimulationWorker and the Unity client. tools/ProtocolGenerator generates Runtime/Generated from this file.

channels.name: ControlChannel
channels.description: Reliable ordered control messages in both directions.

channels.name: MovementInputChannel
channels.description: Sequenced movement input from the client.

channels.name: UnreliableReceiveChannel
channels.description: The channel on which the client receives unreliable snapshots.

limits.name: MaximumIdentifierLength
limits.description: Characters in an identifier such as a session, account, World, or definition id.

limits.name: MaximumNameLength
limits.description: Characters in a display name.

limits.name: MaximumEquipmentSlotIdLength
limits.description: Characters in a canonical equipment slot id.

limits.name: MaximumSlotTagLength
limits.description: Characters in one accepted slot tag.

limits.name: MaximumSlotTags
limits.description: Accepted tags on one slot.

limits.name: MaximumDefinitionIdLength
limits.description: Characters in an item definition id.

limits.name: MaximumInputBatchSize
limits.description: Movement inputs in one batch.

limits.name: MaximumSnapshotEntitiesPerChunk
limits.description: Entity records in one simulation snapshot chunk.

limits.name: MaximumTimestampLength
limits.description: Characters in a round-trip timestamp.

limits.name: MaximumErrorCodeLength
limits.description: Characters in an error, closure, or despawn reason code.

limits.name: MaximumErrorMessageLength
limits.description: Characters in a human-readable error or closure message.

limits.name: MaximumJoinTicketLength
limits.description: Characters in a join ticket.

limits.name: MaximumItemOperationItems
limits.description: Item expectations in one recovery claim.

limits.name: MaximumItemResultItemRevisions
limits.description: Committed item revisions in one item operation result.

limits.name: MaximumItemResultContainerRevisions
limits.description: Committed container revisions in one item operation result.

limits.name: MaximumItemResultRecoveryDeliveries
limits.description: Recovery deliveries in one item operation result.

limits.name: MaximumWorldActorCapabilities
limits.description: Capabilities in one opened world interaction.

limits.name: MaximumWorldActorCapabilityIdLength
limits.description: Characters in a world actor capability id.

limits.name: MaximumWorldActorCapabilityNameLength
limits.description: Characters in a world actor capability display name.

limits.name: MaximumWorldInteractionMessageLength
limits.description: Characters in the optional message of a world interaction result.

limits.name: MaximumCorpsePresencePerChunk
limits.description: Corpses in one presence snapshot chunk.

limits.name: MaximumCorpseViewSlotsPerChunk
limits.description: Slots in one corpse view state chunk.

limits.name: MaximumCorpseChunkCount
limits.description: Chunks in one corpse presence snapshot or corpse view update.

limits.name: MaximumCorpseSourceNameLength
limits.description: Characters in the display name of the corpse's source.

limits.name: MaximumCorpsePresentationKeyLength
limits.description: Characters in a corpse presentation key.

limits.name: MaximumCorpseSectionKindLength
limits.description: Characters in a corpse view section kind.

limits.name: MaximumCorpseSlotKindLength
limits.description: Characters in a corpse slot kind.

limits.name: MaximumCorpseSectionSlotCapacity
limits.description: Slots in one corpse view section.

enums.name: MovementButtons
enums.description: Movement buttons held during one input tick.

enums.name: EntityKind
enums.description: The kind of a replicated simulation entity.

enums.name: CorpseInteractionKind
enums.description: An operation on an open corpse.

enums.name: CorpseViewUpdateKind
enums.description: Whether a corpse view chunk replaces the view or applies a delta.

enums.name: WorldActorKind
enums.description: The kind of a world actor.

enums.name: WorldActorDisposition
enums.description: How a world actor treats players.

enums.name: WorldActorActivityTier
enums.description: How often the worker updates a world actor.

enums.name: WorldActorCapabilityKind
enums.description: A service that a world actor offers.

enums.name: NpcLifecycleActionKind
enums.description: An item lifecycle action that an NPC capability performs.

messages.name: JoinRequest
messages.description: Asks to join a simulation session with a join ticket.

messages.name: JoinAccepted
messages.description: Accepts a join and carries the session, movement settings, and initial state.

messages.name: JoinRejected
messages.description: Rejects a join with a structured error.

messages.name: LeaveRequest
messages.description: Asks to leave the active simulation session.

messages.name: LeaveAccepted
messages.description: Confirms a leave.

messages.name: LeaveRejected
messages.description: Rejects a leave with a structured error.

messages.name: ServerDisconnect
messages.description: Tells the client why the worker ends the connection.

messages.name: MovementInputBatch
messages.description: The newest movement inputs, oldest first.

messages.name: SimulationSnapshot
messages.description: One chunk of the remote entity states visible to the recipient.

messages.name: EntitySpawn
messages.description: An entity entered the recipient's interest.

messages.name: EntityDespawn
messages.description: An entity left the recipient's interest.

messages.name: CarryStateChanged
messages.description: A newer committed carry state.

messages.name: ItemOperationIntent
messages.description: Asks for one in-world item operation.

messages.name: ItemOperationResult
messages.description: The committed or rejected outcome of an item operation.

messages.name: CorpsePresenceSnapshotChunk
messages.description: One chunk of the corpses near the recipient.

messages.name: CorpseInteractionIntent
messages.description: Asks for one operation on a corpse.

messages.name: CorpseInteractionResult
messages.description: The committed or rejected outcome of a corpse operation.

messages.name: CorpseViewStateChunk
messages.description: One chunk of the open corpse view.

messages.name: CorpseViewClosed
messages.description: The worker closed the open corpse view.

messages.name: WorldActorSpawn
messages.description: A world actor entered the recipient's interest.

messages.name: WorldActorState
messages.description: A newer state of a visible world actor.

messages.name: WorldActorDespawn
messages.description: A world actor left the recipient's interest.

messages.name: WorldInteractionIntent
messages.description: Asks to open, close, or act on a world interaction.

messages.name: WorldInteractionOpened
messages.description: An opened world interaction and its capabilities.

messages.name: WorldInteractionResult
messages.description: The outcome of a world interaction intent.

messages.name: WorldInteractionClosed
messages.description: The worker closed a world interaction.

messages.name: OwnerSimulationSnapshot
messages.description: The owner's authoritative state and input acknowledgement for reconciliation.
